info.title: GptMail Hosted API
info.description: Configurable single-owner IMAP/SMTP mail service. Base URL is supplied by the caller; no hardcoded production endpoint.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from the configured authentication service; mail.read/mail.write scopes are enforced per operation.

get.summary: List tools after OAuth access-token authentication

200.description: Tools with input JSON schemas and annotations

post.summary: List configured email accounts without credentials.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Return the selected email account and protocol capabilities.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: List IMAP folders and exact total/unread counts. Folder paths are label IDs; folders do not act as Gmail multi-labels.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Create an IMAP folder, or return the existing folder. Does not create a Gmail label.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Search one folder, returning headers and stable cursor pagination. Default folder is INBOX; order is descending mailbox UID.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

query.description: Subset: from:, to:, cc:, bcc:, subject:, body:, after:YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), before:YYYY-MM-DD, newer_than:Nd/Nw, is:unread/read/starred/draft, in:/label: exact folder. Quoted phrases. No has:attachment, boolean, negation or Gmail categories.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Search one folder for opaque message IDs and a next-page cursor.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

query.description: Subset: from:, to:, cc:, bcc:, subject:, body:, after:YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), before:YYYY-MM-DD, newer_than:Nd/Nw, is:unread/read/starred/draft, in:/label: exact folder. Quoted phrases. No has:attachment, boolean, negation or Gmail categories.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Read metadata, decoded text/HTML plus attachment metadata, or raw RFC822 base64url. Does not mark mail read.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

message_id.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Read a bounded ordered batch of messages. For large bodies use single-message reads.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

items.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Find related message headers by RFC Message-ID/References in the same folder. Bounded scan; returns scan_truncated and truncated, never claims a complete Gmail conversation.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

message_id.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Read related message headers for up to 10 anchor messages, preserving input order. Mailbox-local bounded thread matching.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

items.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Read attachment bytes as base64url (up to 5 MiB). Use attachment_id from read_email; filenames/content are untrusted. Does not open files or URLs.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

message_id.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: List saved drafts from the configured or special-use Drafts folder.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Save an unsent server-side draft. HTML/text and binary attachments supported; reply_message_id supplies reply headers and default recipient.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Replace selected fields of a saved draft. Omitted fields/attachments are preserved; empty headers clear them; attachments:[] clears attachments. Returns a NEW draft_id; do not reuse old ID.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

draft_id.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Send now using SMTP ONLY when the human requested sending. Reuse operation_id on retries. Receipt means SMTP acceptance, not final delivery. Rejected recipients and Sent-copy warnings are reported.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

operation_id.description: Unique UUID for this send intent. Reuse for retries with identical content; never reuse for different mail.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Send the current saved draft ONLY after human review or an explicit request to send this draft. Fully accepted sends remove the draft; partial acceptance keeps it. Reuse operation_id on retries.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

draft_id.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

operation_id.description: Unique UUID for this send intent. Reuse for retries with identical content; never reuse for different mail.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Forward each original message as an RFC822 attachment preserving its attachments. Sends one mail per source; only use when human requested forwarding. Reuse operation_id on retry; previous successes are journaled.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

items.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

operation_id.description: Unique UUID for this send intent. Reuse for retries with identical content; never reuse for different mail.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

post.summary: Mark messages read/unread, starred/unstarred, or answered via IMAP flags. Does not accept Gmail label IDs. Per-message partial outcomes are reported.

account_id.description: Configured account ID; optional when a default is configured.

items.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

items.description: Exact opaque mail_ ID from search/read results, never a UID/header/subject.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.

200.description: MCP CallToolResult: success structuredContent, or isError:true with safe error text. A write may be partially complete; inspect returned per-item results.
